v4.6.77 — Broker scoping + stale universe fixes

🐛 FIXED
• A bot you mark for ONE broker no longer shows up under the other. The “Available to add” list was showing every custom bot regardless of broker — now an IBKR-only bot appears only under IBKR (and an Alpaca-only bot only under Alpaca), in both the bot list and the IBKR allocation tab.
• Your broker checkboxes in Make Bot are now the source of truth for a new bot’s broker(s) — if you tick only IBKR, the bot is IBKR-only even if the AI tried to tag it for both.
• Existing bots are re-checked against their own file, so they get scoped correctly too.
• Removed the stale “crypto” universe card that lingered in the Universe tab from a deleted crypto bot — universe cards now only show for bots you actually have.

Update via the in-app banner.
